desc: Derive and validate the boundary transformation for the \(k \cdot i\) contribution.
Implement the \(O(n^2)\) one-dimensional DP with correct handling of the first segment and final \(kB_n\) constant.
Test the implementation on the provided examples and exhaustive small brute-force partitions.
Identify prefix sums as the basis for constant-time segment-cost evaluation.
Recognize that the naive segment-count DP is unnecessary after boundary transformation.
